name: Vulcan
def: Warehouse picking robot from Amazon with force sensing grippers, described by the company as its first robot with a sense of touch.
facts: Stows and picks items in the fabric pods of Amazon fulfilment centres
Shown in May 2025, working in Spokane and Hamburg
